primitives.name: Maximum Momentum Principle
primitives.verbatim_quote: By this is meant that a back should run with his chin and elbows tucked in and his weight well in hand, so that when necessary he can change direction.
primitives.assumptions: Constant mass, linear acceleration, point particle approximation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Momentum dissipation upon collision with defenders.

layer2.mapping: GSI - Maximum Information Transfer: maximize signal-to-noise ratio in directional drive.
layer2.telemetry: Change in velocity before vs after contact.

primitives.name: Collected Running Technique
primitives.verbatim_quote: On open-field play, lead out into the open, draw the defensive field, pick your opportunity, and reverse it by cutting back through the defensive players.
primitives.assumptions: Minimal drag coefficient, concentrated mass distribution, angular momentum conservation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Loss of form leading to deceleration or fumble.

layer2.mapping: GSE - Efficient State Transitions: minimize rotational inertia during directional changes.

primitives.name: Open Field Reversal Strategy
primitives.verbatim_quote: After passing the line of scrimmage, fix the ball under one arm and use the other hand and arm on the defensive players.
primitives.assumptions: Homogeneous player density, predictable reaction time, bounded utility function.

layer2.mapping: GSI - Adaptive Exploitation: dynamically adjust offensive pressure based on defensive response.
layer2.telemetry: Yards gained versus defensive pressure applied.

primitives.name: Ball Fixation Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Talk to one another at all times, checking up on defensive territory and down and distance.
primitives.assumptions: Fixed grip strength, constant ball orientation, minimal air resistance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Ball loss due to insufficient retention force.

layer2.mapping: GSE - Critical State Transitions: secure possession during high-risk phases of play.
layer2.telemetry: Ball security index (e.g., forced fumbles per carry).
